SEEKING FREELANCE / CONTRACT WORK

Location: Ukraine Remote: Yes Willing to relocate: No

Technologies: C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, WebSockets, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, trading/exchange APIs

Focus: Trading automation and backend engineering — broker/exchange API integrations, order execution, webhook-to-trading backends, reconnect/restart recovery, duplicate-order prevention, partial fills, reconciliation, risk controls, logging and monitoring.

I can also troubleshoot and improve existing trading bots and integrations.

The client provides the strategy, signals, or trading rules; I focus on the engineering and execution infrastructure.

Availability: 30+ hrs/week

GitHub / source code: https://github.com/avysotsky/TradeOps

Upwork / Project Catalog: https://www.upwork.com/services/product/development-it-a-rel...
